subject: Priv deployment: Phase 2 environment split + term adjustments
messages:
From: Amit Desai <amit.desai@stellarcare.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: infra-ops@stellarcare.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priv deployment: Phase 2 environment split + term adjustments

Sofia,

Thanks again for the workshop yesterday — the team left with a clear sense for what Redwood Private gives us. We're ready to move forward with a Phase 2 rollout but have a couple of asks that will affect contracting and timing:

- We need a completely isolated environment (separate VPC + dedicated clusters) for our PCI-adjacent workloads.
- We'd like the option to spin up an extra cold standby cluster in another AZ for DR.
- Procurement would like to align a term extension to cover the additional capacity; they're asking for two options (12 months vs 24 months) and a clear delta in unit pricing.

Can you share a draft SOW and a high-level pricing sketch? Also attaching our current network diagram and a short compliance checklist so your infra team can confirm port/IP needs.

Timeline: procurement wants an internal review by 2027-04-12 so we can sign before the start of Q3.

Attachments: network_diagram_stellarcare.png (image/png), compliance_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Amit
Amit Desai
Head of Infra Ops, StellarCare Health
amit.desai@stellarcare.com

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Amit Desai <amit.desai@stellarcare.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deployment: Phase 2 environment split + term adjustments

Hi Amit — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments.

High-level response and next steps:

1) Isolation model: we can provision a separate Private environment (dedicated VPC + dedicated GPU cluster fleet). The cold standby in a second AZ is supported; we'll size it as warm/cold depending on RTO requirements.

2) Term/pricing options (ballpark):
   - 12-month term: standard private pricing + one-time provisioning fee of $45k; additional cluster nodes at list price.
   - 24-month term: 12% committed-discount on monthly capacity charges and waive the provisioning fee. If you commit to the standby cluster capacity in the 24-month deal we can offer a further 3% discount (net 15%).

3) Deliverables I'll share by EOD 2027-04-03: draft SOW (SOW_phase2_v1.pdf), a short MAP (mutual action plan) with dates, and a technical appendix with IP/port list.

4) Procurement timing: we can support your 2027-04-12 internal review if we lock on scope by 2027-04-06. Suggest a technical sync tomorrow to confirm network constraints.

I've attached a first-pass SOW and a checklist — these are drafts so feel free to mark up.

Attachments: SOW_phase2_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Amit Desai <amit.desai@stellarcare.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@procurecorp.com>, infra-ops@stellarcare.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deployment: Phase 2 environment split + term adjustments

Thanks Sofia — this looks promising. A couple of quick clarifications:

> 1) Isolation model: we can provision a separate Private environment (dedicated VPC + dedicated GPU cluster fleet). The cold standby in a second AZ is supported; we'll size it as warm/cold depending on RTO requirements.

Can you confirm required peering/egress IP ranges and whether Redwood needs any inbound connections to our management plane? Our security team will need concrete network details.

> 2) Term/pricing options (ballpark): 12 mo vs 24 mo with discounts

Procurement copied — Elena will coordinate the contract language. For the 24-month option we need a clause that allows for a one-time capacity increase at preserved pricing if we exercise it within the first 6 months. Is that doable?

We'll also need a redline-friendly SOW and DOCUSIGN link for our legal team.

Quoted for context: "Timeline: procurement wants an internal review by 2027-04-12" — we'll aim for that but please confirm MAP dates.

Amit

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deployment: Phase 2 environment split + term adjustments

Internal note before we send the formal response to StellarCare:

- Recommended commercial approach: present both 12/24 options but push 24-month as the preferred path (better unit economics). Offer the 24-month with a 15% committed discount if they commit to the standby cluster at signing. That preserves margin and meets procurement's "preserved pricing for one-time increase" ask — we can include language: "one-time capacity add within first 6 months at current contracted rates, subject to inventory availability."

- Provisioning fee: waive if they sign > $500k ARR equivalent commit (we should calculate exact ARR target based on their expected node counts; I'll ask infra for a sizing estimate).

- SOW: add explicit acceptance tests for environment isolation and DR failover timeline (48 hours cold start target).

I'll draft the commercial paragraph and a redline-friendly SOW appendix. Sofia/Marissa — once the MAP and SOW are updated, we should push the doc to DocuSign and include Elena for legal review.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
